response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT c.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanconservation c2 JOIN sites s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = c2.zoneref) AS frac FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, cnt, frac FROM g WHERE frac >= COALESCE((SELECT frac FROM g ORDER BY frac DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9), -1) ORDER BY frac DESC
